literal_meaning: কানের গোচরে আসা (ear's range/perception within coming)
figurative_meaning_en: Something that has been heard or come to one's ears
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অসুস্থতার কথা কয়েকদিন আগে আমার কর্ণগোচর হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: This news has come to my ears.
I heard about his illness a few days ago.
